title: Peppa Pig Theme
blurb: Snorts, bouncing strings, and a cast introducing themselves one by one. To small children the Peppa Pig intro is the finest television ever made. To their parents it is a sound that arrives roughly four hundred times a week and never entirely leaves the house. It has also become a full internet meme in its own right, remixed into everything from drill tracks to horror edits. Play it in any room containing a toddler and watch how fast the effect lands.
origin: The opening theme of Peppa Pig (Astley Baker Davies, 2004).
